title: Pickleball | Calm Joints
description: A short pickleball kit for between games, and a video assessment with a registered physiotherapist.
sub: Pickleball is quick at the kitchen and hard on knees, shoulders and feet. Here’s a short kit for between games, and a video assessment with a registered physiotherapist if you’d like to talk through how you move.
